FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Stitch & Fabric Haven, we specialize in providing a wide range of high-quality fabrics, sewing supplies, and related notions to our community of crafting enthusiasts. Our core operations include the retail sale of fabrics, sewing machines, threads, patterns, and other accessories required for sewing and quilting projects. We also offer sewing classes and workshops to engage our customers and enhance their crafting skills, all while ensuring that all instructors are required to carry their own insurance to mitigate liability exposure. We comply with all local safety regulations and have implemented comprehensive fire safety measures, including the installation of fire extinguishers and clearly marked evacuation routes, to ensure a safe shopping environment for our customers. As a passionate team dedicated to crafting, we strive to create a welcoming atmosphere for individuals of all skill levels, helping them bring their creative visions to life.

Our store specializes in selling a wide range of sewing fabrics, including cotton, silk, and several synthetic materials, all of which are stored in bulk to meet customer demand. We also offer a variety of sewing supplies like threads and notions, which may include flammable components.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Fire damage on 09/15/2023 due to a faulty electrical circuit in the sewing machine area, resulting in a loss of $4,500. Claim status: Under review.
